title: ASPIRE: Make Spectral Graph Collaborative Filtering Great Again via Adaptive Filter Learning
abstract: arXiv:2604.22549v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph filter design is central to spectral collaborative filtering, yet most existing methods rely on manually tuned hyperparameters rather than fully learnable filters. We show that this challenge stems from a bias in traditional recommendation objectives, which induces a spectral phenomenon termed low-frequency explosion, thereby fundamentally hindering the effective learning of graph filters. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel adaptive spectral graph collaborative filtering framework (ASPIRE) based on a bi-level optimization objective. Guided by our theoretical analysis, we disentangle the filter learning objective, which in turn leads to excellent recommendation performance, spectral adaptivity, and training stability in practice. translated_title: ASPIRE：通过自适应滤波器学习让谱图协同过滤重振雄风
translated_abstract: 图滤波器设计是谱协同过滤的核心，然而大多数现有方法依赖于手动调整的超参数，而非完全可学习的滤波器。我们证明这一挑战源于传统推荐目标中存在的偏差，该偏差引发了一种被称为“低频爆炸”的谱现象，从而从根本上阻碍了图滤波器的有效学习。为克服这一局限性，我们提出了一种基于双层优化目标的新型自适应谱图协同过滤框架（ASPIRE）。在我们的理论分析指导下，我们对滤波器学习目标进行了解耦，进而在实践中带来了卓越的推荐性能、谱自适应性以及训练稳定性。大量实验表明，我们学习到的滤波器能够匹敌精心设计的任务特定滤波器的性能。此外，ASPIRE在基于大语言模型（LLM）的协同过滤中同样有效……
tldr: 本文提出ASPIRE框架，通过双层优化目标学习自适应图滤波器，克服了传统推荐目标偏差导致的“低频爆炸”问题，使谱图协同过滤达到与精心手工设计的滤波器相当的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ASPIRE, a bi-level optimization-based framework that learns adaptive graph filters to overcome the "low-frequency explosion" problem caused by bias in traditional recommendation objectives, enabling spectral graph collaborative filtering to match carefully engineered task-specific filter designs.
